title: cloud-connection: the Cloud Connection settings page says the same sentence twice (page description and card body); the card body should say the state and what the button does, item 3 of objectui#12610
body:
Filing gate ③: the objectstack half of objectstack-ai/objectui#12610 item 3 (filed by the epic PM from the 2026-10-16 Setup review, under the maintainer's 「全部立卡」). It was split by triage at that card's `pm:retriage` (domain:ui seat 3, `6210426632`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` seat (`packages/cloud-connection`).
- The claim declares the one translation line in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.ts` to the `domain:engine` seat, on the cross-domain exception path.

## What the admin reads

On `page/cloud_connection_settings`, the page description and the card body are the same sentence: "Connect this runtime to an ObjectStack control plane to browse your organization's private packages and install them here."

It is produced in `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-ui.ts` and in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.ts`, as seat 3 located.

## The change

- The page description keeps the one sentence.
- The card body says what the current state is (connected or not, and to which control plane) and what the button does.
- The other locales move with it.

## Grade

**p2.** It is admin-facing copy.

## Dedupe

The parent is objectstack-ai/objectui#12610.
